verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ Καταβάντος ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους πολλοί ὄχλοι ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de autou Katabantos apo tou orous polloi ochloi ēkolouthēsan autō
verses.literal: When [Jesus] came down from the mountain large crowds followed Him

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ λεπρὸς προσελθὼν προσεκύνει αὐτῷ λέγων Κύριε ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί καθαρίσαι με
verses.transliteration: kai idou lepros proselthōn prosekynei autō legōn Kyrie ean thelēs dynasai katharisai me
verses.literal: Suddenly . . . a leper came [and] knelt before Him saying Lord if You are willing You can make me clean . . .

verses.original: Καὶ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα ἥψατο αὐτοῦ Θέλω λέγων καθαρίσθητι καὶ εὐθέως αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα ἐκαθαρίσθη
verses.transliteration: Kai ekteinas tēn cheira hēpsato autou Thelō legōn katharisthēti kai eutheōs autou hē lepra ekatharisthē
verses.literal: - [Jesus] reached out [His] hand [and] touched [the man] I am willing He said Be clean And immediately his - leprosy was cleansed

verses.original: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτῷ Ὅρα εἴπῃς μηδενὶ ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε δεῖξον σεαυτὸν τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ προσένεγκον τὸ δῶρον ὃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai ho Iēsous legei autō Hora eipēs mēdeni alla hypage deixon seauton tō hierei kai prosenenkon to dōron ho prosetaxen Mōusēs eis martyrion autois
verses.literal: Then - Jesus instructed him See that you don’t tell anyone . . . But go show yourself to the priest and offer the gift - prescribed by Moses as a testimony to them

verses.original: δὲ αὐτοῦ Εἰσελθόντος εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ ἑκατόνταρχος προσῆλθεν αὐτῷ παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: de autou Eiselthontos eis Kapharnaoum hekatontarchos prosēlthen autō parakalōn auton
verses.literal: When [Jesus] had entered . . . Capernaum a centurion came - [and] pleaded with Him

verses.original: καὶ λέγων Κύριε ὁ μου παῖς βέβληται ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ παραλυτικός δεινῶς βασανιζόμενος
verses.transliteration: kai legōn Kyrie ho mou pais beblētai en tē oikia paralytikos deinōs basanizomenos
verses.literal: - - Lord - my servant lies at - home paralyzed [and] in terrible agony

verses.original: Ἐγὼ ἐλθὼν θεραπεύσω αὐτόν Καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Egō elthōn therapeusō auton Kai legei autō
verses.literal: I will go [and] heal him - [Jesus] replied -

verses.original: δὲ ὁ ἑκατόνταρχος Ἀποκριθεὶς ἔφη Κύριε εἰμὶ οὐκ ἱκανὸς ἵνα εἰσέλθῃς ὑπὸ μου τὴν στέγην ἀλλὰ μόνον εἰπὲ λόγῳ καὶ ὁ μου παῖς ἰαθήσεται
verses.transliteration: de ho hekatontarchos Apokritheis ephē Kyrie eimi ouk hikanos hina eiselthēs hypo mou tēn stegēn alla monon eipe logō kai ho mou pais iathēsetai
verses.literal: - The centurion answered . . . Lord I am not worthy to have You come under my - roof But just say the word and - my servant will be healed

verses.original: γὰρ ἐγὼ καὶ εἰμι ἄνθρωπός ὑπὸ ἐξουσίαν ἔχων στρατιώτας ὑπ’ ἐμαυτὸν καὶ λέγω τούτῳ Πορεύθητι καὶ πορεύεται καὶ ἄλλῳ Ἔρχου καὶ ἔρχεται καὶ τῷ μου δούλῳ Ποίησον τοῦτο καὶ ποιεῖ
verses.transliteration: gar egō kai eimi anthrōpos hypo exousian echōn stratiōtas hyp’ emauton kai legō toutō Poreuthēti kai poreuetai kai allō Erchou kai erchetai kai tō mou doulō Poiēson touto kai poiei
verses.literal: For I myself am a man under authority with soldiers under me - I tell [one] to go and he goes and another to come and he comes [I tell] - my servant to do something and he does [it]

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀκούσας ἐθαύμασεν καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἀκολουθοῦσιν Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν εὗρον οὐδενὶ παρ’ ἐν τῷ Ἰσραὴλ τοσαύτην πίστιν
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Akousas ethaumasen kai eipen tois akolouthousin Amēn legō hymin heuron oudeni par’ en tō Israēl tosautēn pistin
verses.literal: When - Jesus heard [this] He marveled and said to those following [Him] Truly I tell you I have not found anyone . . . . . . in - Israel [with] such great faith

verses.original: δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πολλοὶ ἥξουσιν ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ δυσμῶν καὶ ἀνακλιθήσονται μετὰ Ἀβραὰμ καὶ Ἰσαὰκ καὶ Ἰακὼβ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῶν οὐρανῶν
verses.transliteration: de legō hymin hoti polloi hēxousin apo anatolōn kai dysmōn kai anaklithēsontai meta Abraam kai Isaak kai Iakōb en tē basileia tōn ouranōn
verses.literal: - I say to you that many will come from [the] east and [the] west - to share the banquet with Abraham - Isaac and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven

verses.original: δὲ οἱ υἱοὶ τῆς βασιλείας ἐκβληθήσονται εἰς τὸ τὸ ἐξώτερον σκότος ἐκεῖ ἔσται ὁ κλαυθμὸς καὶ ὁ βρυγμὸς τῶν ὀδόντων
verses.transliteration: de hoi huioi tēs basileias ekblēthēsontai eis to to exōteron skotos ekei estai ho klauthmos kai ho brygmos tōn odontōn
verses.literal: But the sons of the kingdom will be thrown into the - outer darkness [where] there will be - weeping and - gnashing - of teeth

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τῷ ἑκατοντάρχῃ Ὕπαγε ὡς ἐπίστευσας γενηθήτω σοι καὶ ὁ αὐτοῦ παῖς ἰάθη ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous eipen tō hekatontarchē Hypage hōs episteusas genēthētō soi kai ho autou pais iathē en ekeinē tē hōra
verses.literal: Then - Jesus said to the centurion Go As you have believed [so] will it be done for you And - his servant was healed at that very - hour

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλθὼν εἰς Πέτρου τὴν οἰκίαν εἶδεν τὴν αὐτοῦ πενθερὰν βεβλημένην καὶ πυρέσσουσαν
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous elthōn eis Petrou tēn oikian eiden tēn autou pentheran beblēmenēn kai pyressousan
verses.literal: When - Jesus arrived at Peter’s - house He saw - [Peter’s] mother-in-law sick in bed vvv with a fever

verses.original: καὶ ἥψατο τῆς αὐτῆς χειρὸς καὶ ὁ πυρετός ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν καὶ ἠγέρθη καὶ διηκόνει αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai hēpsato tēs autēs cheiros kai ho pyretos aphēken autēn kai ēgerthē kai diēkonei autō
verses.literal: So He touched - her hand and the fever left her and she got up and began to serve Him

verses.original: δὲ Ὀψίας γενομένης πολλούς δαιμονιζομένους προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τὰ πνεύματα λόγῳ καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν πάντας τοὺς ἔχοντας κακῶς
verses.transliteration: de Opsias genomenēs pollous daimonizomenous prosēnenkan autō kai exebalen ta pneumata logō kai etherapeusen pantas tous echontas kakōs
verses.literal: When evening came many who were demon-possessed were brought to [Jesus] and He drove out the spirits with a word and healed all the vvv sick

verses.original: ὅπως πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν διὰ τοῦ προφήτου Ἠσαΐου λέγοντος ἔλαβεν Αὐτὸς τὰς ἡμῶν ἀσθενείας καὶ ἐβάστασεν τὰς νόσους
verses.transliteration: hopōs plērōthē to rhēthen dia tou prophētou Ēsaiou legontos elaben Autos tas hēmōn astheneias kai ebastasen tas nosous
verses.literal: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah - He took up . . . - our infirmities and carried our diseases

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἰδὼν πολλοὺς ὄχλον περὶ αὐτὸν ἐκέλευσεν ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὸ πέραν
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Idōn pollous ochlon peri auton ekeleusen apelthein eis to peran
verses.literal: [When] - Jesus saw [a] large crowd around Him He gave orders to cross to the other side [of the sea]

verses.original: Καὶ εἷς γραμματεὺς προσελθὼν αὐτῷ εἶπεν Διδάσκαλε ἀκολουθήσω σοι ὅπου ἐὰν ἀπέρχῃ
verses.transliteration: Kai heis grammateus proselthōn autō eipen Didaskale akolouthēsō soi hopou ean aperchē
verses.literal: And one of the scribes came to Him [and] said Teacher I will follow You wherever - You go

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτῷ Αἱ ἀλώπεκες ἔχουσιν φωλεοὺς καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνώσεις ὁ δὲ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔχει οὐκ ποῦ κλίνῃ τὴν κεφαλὴν
verses.transliteration: Kai ho Iēsous legei autō Hai alōpekes echousin phōleous kai ta peteina tou ouranou kataskēnōseis ho de Huios tou anthrōpou echei ouk pou klinē tēn kephalēn
verses.literal: - - Jesus replied - - Foxes have dens and - birds of the air [have] nests - but [the] Son - of Man has no [place] to lay [His] head

verses.original: δὲ Ἕτερος τῶν αὐτοῦ μαθητῶν εἶπεν αὐτῷ Κύριε πρῶτον ἐπίτρεψόν μοι ἀπελθεῖν καὶ θάψαι τὸν μου πατέρα
verses.transliteration: de Heteros tōn autou mathētōn eipen autō Kyrie prōton epitrepson moi apelthein kai thapsai ton mou patera
verses.literal: - Another - of His disciples requested - Lord first let me go and bury - my father

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτῷ Ἀκολούθει μοι καὶ ἄφες τοὺς νεκροὺς θάψαι τοὺς ἑαυτῶν νεκρούς
verses.transliteration: de Ho Iēsous legei autō Akolouthei moi kai aphes tous nekrous thapsai tous heautōn nekrous
verses.literal: But - Jesus told him Follow Me and let the dead bury - their own dead

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτῷ ἐμβάντι εἰς τὸ πλοῖον αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai autō embanti eis to ploion autou hoi mathētai ēkolouthēsan autō
verses.literal: [When] He got into . . . the boat His - disciples followed Him

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ μέγας σεισμὸς ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ ὥστε τὸ πλοῖον καλύπτεσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν κυμάτων δὲ αὐτὸς ἐκάθευδεν
verses.transliteration: kai idou megas seismos egeneto en tē thalassē hōste to ploion kalyptesthai hypo tōn kymatōn de autos ekatheuden
verses.literal: Suddenly . . . a violent storm came up on the sea so that the boat was engulfed by the waves But [Jesus] was sleeping

verses.original: καὶ προσελθόντες ἤγειραν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Κύριε σῶσον ἀπολλύμεθα
verses.transliteration: kai proselthontes ēgeiran auton legontes Kyrie sōson apollymetha
verses.literal: - [The disciples] went [and] woke Him saying Lord save us We are perishing

verses.original: ὀλιγόπιστοι Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Τί ἐστε δειλοί τότε ἐγερθεὶς ἐπετίμησεν τοῖς ἀνέμοις καὶ τῇ θαλάσσῃ καὶ ἐγένετο μεγάλη γαλήνη
verses.transliteration: oligopistoi Kai legei autois Ti este deiloi tote egertheis epetimēsen tois anemois kai tē thalassē kai egeneto megalē galēnē
verses.literal: [You] of little faith - [Jesus] replied . . . why are you so afraid Then He got up [and] rebuked the winds and the sea and it was perfectly calm

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ ἄνθρωποι ἐθαύμασαν λέγοντες Ποταπός ἐστιν οὗτος ὅτι καὶ οἱ ἄνεμοι καὶ ἡ θάλασσα ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Hoi de anthrōpoi ethaumasan legontes Potapos estin houtos hoti kai hoi anemoi kai hē thalassa hypakouousin autō
verses.literal: - - [The] men were amazed [and] asked What kind [of man] is this - Even the winds and the sea obey Him

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοῦ ἐλθόντος εἰς τὸ πέραν εἰς τὴν χώραν τῶν Γαδαρηνῶν ὑπήντησαν αὐτῷ δύο δαιμονιζόμενοι ἐξερχόμενοι ἐκ τῶν μνημείων λίαν χαλεποὶ ὥστε μὴ τινὰ ἰσχύειν παρελθεῖν διὰ ἐκείνης τῆς ὁδοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai autou elthontos eis to peran eis tēn chōran tōn Gadarēnōn hypēntēsan autō dyo daimonizomenoi exerchomenoi ek tōn mnēmeiōn lian chalepoi hōste mē tina ischyein parelthein dia ekeinēs tēs hodou
verses.literal: When [Jesus] arrived on the other side in the region of the Gadarenes He was met by . . . two demon-possessed [men] coming from the tombs [They were] so violent that no one could pass . . . that - way

verses.original: Τί σοί καὶ ἡμῖν Υἱὲ τοῦ Θεοῦ Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔκραξαν λέγοντες ἦλθες ὧδε βασανίσαι ἡμᾶς πρὸ καιροῦ
verses.transliteration: Ti soi kai hēmin Huie tou Theou Kai idou ekraxan legontes ēlthes hōde basanisai hēmas pro kairou
verses.literal: What do You [want] - with us Son - of God - - they shouted - Have You come here to torture us before [the] appointed time

verses.original: δὲ μακρὰν ἀπ’ αὐτῶν πολλῶν ἀγέλη χοίρων Ἦν βοσκομένη
verses.transliteration: de makran ap’ autōn pollōn agelē choirōn Ēn boskomenē
verses.literal: - In the distance . . . . . . a large herd of pigs was feeding

verses.original: δὲ οἱ δαίμονες παρεκάλουν αὐτὸν λέγοντες Εἰ ἐκβάλλεις ἡμᾶς ἀπόστειλον ἡμᾶς εἰς τὴν ἀγέλην τῶν χοίρων
verses.transliteration: de hoi daimones parekaloun auton legontes Ei ekballeis hēmas aposteilon hēmas eis tēn agelēn tōn choirōn
verses.literal: So the demons begged [Jesus] - If You drive us out . . . send us . . . into the herd - of pigs

verses.original: Ὑπάγετε Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς οἱ δὲ ἐξελθόντες ἀπῆλθον εἰς τοὺς χοίρους καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ πᾶσα ἀγέλη ὥρμησεν κατὰ τοῦ κρημνοῦ εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ ἀπέθανον ἐν τοῖς ὕδασιν
verses.transliteration: Hypagete Kai eipen autois hoi de exelthontes apēlthon eis tous choirous kai idou hē pasa agelē hōrmēsen kata tou krēmnou eis tēn thalassan kai apethanon en tois hydasin
verses.literal: Go - He told them - So they came out and went into the pigs and - the whole herd rushed down the steep bank into the sea and died in the waters

verses.original: δὲ Οἱ βόσκοντες ἔφυγον καὶ ἀπελθόντες εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀπήγγειλαν πάντα καὶ τὰ τῶν δαιμονιζομένων
verses.transliteration: de Hoi boskontes ephygon kai apelthontes eis tēn polin apēngeilan panta kai ta tōn daimonizomenōn
verses.literal: - Those tending [the pigs] ran off . . . . . . into the town [and] reported all this including the [account] of the demon-possessed [men]

verses.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡ πᾶσα πόλις ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ὑπάντησιν τῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἰδόντες αὐτὸν παρεκάλεσαν ὅπως μεταβῇ ἀπὸ τῶν αὐτῶν ὁρίων
verses.transliteration: kai idou hē pasa polis exēlthen eis hypantēsin tō Iēsou kai idontes auton parekalesan hopōs metabē apo tōn autōn horiōn
verses.literal: Then . . . the whole town went out to meet - Jesus And when they saw Him they begged [Him] - to leave . . . - their region
